headlines.title: Jim Cramer: Anthropic’s “Next $100 Billion in Revenue” Might Be Cybersecurity. CrowdStrike Should Worry
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysDays before Anthropic’s IPO, Jim Cramer named cybersecurity as a possible source of the AI lab’s next $100 billion in revenue, given how good Claude is at spotting code vulnerabilities. A bigger Claude security push would make Anthropic a direct competitor to CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks, which both jumped nearly 3% early on Nov.

headlines.title: CrowdStrike Doubles Down on AI Agents With $495 Million in Deals After a Record $333 Million ARR Quarter
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysCrowdStrike agreed to buy Fiddler AI and Dreadnode, two AI agent security startups, for about $495 million, The Wall Street Journal reported. Net new ARR hit a record $333 million last quarter, up 51%, and CEO George Kurtz called it “the best quarter in CrowdStrike’s history.

headlines.title: Why CrowdStrike (CRWD), a Jim Cramer Holding, Wants Fiddler AI
headlines.summary: We just published the list of Inside Jim Cramer’s Charitable Trust: 10 Stocks He Actually Owns, and CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:CRWD) ranked 10th on this list. Jim Cramer started his Charitable Trust in 2005 with $3 million of his own money.

headlines.title: CrowdStrike (CRWD) Stock Trades At A Premium To Sales
headlines.summary: CrowdStrike Holdings has produced a very strong share-price story over the past few years, which naturally raises a simple question for you as an investor: Is the current US$229.87 price tag still grounded in what the cybersecurity specialist is generating in sales? Over the past 3 years, CrowdStrike has delivered a very large 350.1% total return, which puts extra weight on whether revenue can keep carrying that kind of value creation argument.

description: CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. provides cybersecurity solutions in the United States and internationally. Its unified platform provides cloud-delivered protection of endpoints, cloud workloads, identity, and data through a software as a service (SaaS) subscription-based model. The company offers corporate endpoint and cloud workload security, managed security, security and vulnerability management, IT operations management, identity protection, threat intelligence, data protection, SaaS security posture management, and AI powered workflow automation, and securing generative AI workload services, as well as security orchestration, automation, and response; and security information and event management, and log management services. It primarily sells subscriptions to its Falcon platform and cloud modules. The company has a strategic alliance with Cognizant Technology Solutions Corporation to help enterprises secure artificial intelligence across its lifecycle, from the AI agents and models to the foundational infrastructure that supports the entire AI ecosystem and with Snowflake to bring AI-native security and enterprise data at scale. Additionally, it has a partnership with Fortanix Inc. to combine its Falcon platform with Fortanix Confidential AI to provide an integrated solution for end-to-end AI security. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Austin, Texas.
